summary.headline: Himadri posted record FY26 consolidated PAT of INR 755 crores (+36% YoY) and Q4 PAT of INR 208 crores (+34%), with EBITDA at INR 1,006 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported record quarterly and full-year consolidated EBITDA and PAT, with Q4 revenue up 14% YoY to about INR 1,288 crores. FY26 saw commissioning of 70,000 MT speciality carbon black capacity at Mahistikry (total 130,000 MT speciality, 250,000 MT overall) and de-bottlenecking of coal-tar pitch distillation to 600,000 MTPA. The company commissioned its first anode material plant (200 MTPA) on 23 April 2026 and reiterated LFP cathode Phase 1 (40,000 MTPA, INR 1,125 crores) timelines. Management guided to top-line and bottom-line growth in FY27 without giving numerical guidance, and reaffirmed a FY28 PAT target of INR 1,100+ crores.

financial_highlights.change: down from INR 392 crores per analyst question
first year of operations post revival

segments.name: Speciality carbon black
segments.commentary: Added 70,000 MT at Mahistikry, taking speciality capacity to 130,000 MTPA; management expects 85-90% utilisation on new capacity in FY27 and EBITDA/MT of about INR 17,000 on average across the basket, with speciality grades higher.

segments.name: Coal tar pitch (CTP)
segments.commentary: Distillation de-bottlenecked to 600,000 MTPA; liquid CTP export terminals commissioned at Haldia and Mangalore; by FY28 management expects 100,000 tons of new capacity, of which 50,000 tons to be exported.

segments.name: Lithium-ion battery materials
segments.commentary: Anode plant at Mahistikry (200 MTPA) commissioned 23 April 2026, in-house tech; sampling with OEMs. LFP cathode Phase 1 of 40,000 MTPA (INR 1,125 crores capex) with first 2,000 MT by Q3 FY27 and full operation by FY29; asset turn about 2x.

segments.name: Birla Tyres (others)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 187 crores in first year post-revival; 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers. Management targets about INR 3,000 crores top line in next four years; PCR capacity targeted for commissioning in 24 months, focused on EV tyres.

segments.name: Anthraquinone and carbazole
segments.commentary: Project progressing as planned, expected to commission in Q2 FY27 to reduce import dependence in India.

guidance_outlook: FY27: management expects both top-line and bottom-line growth, with top-line growth coming from new capacities; no numerical guidance given.
Reiterated commitment to double FY25 PAT of INR 555 crores to INR 1,100+ crores in FY28.
Margin expansion expected to continue; management said it is confident of sustaining ~20% EBITDA margin and strengthening margins from here on.
Birla Tyres: utilisation to be ramped over next 12-24 months; target ~INR 3,000 crores revenue in four years.
Cathode Phase 1 full 40,000 MTPA operations by FY29; anode large-scale capex to be announced later.
Anode Sicona SiCx capacity expansion targeted for completion by Q2 FY27.
capex_capacity: Speciality carbon black: 70,000 MT added at Mahistikry in FY26; total speciality 130,000 MTPA, overall carbon black 250,000 MTPA.
Anode: first 200 MTPA plant at Mahistikry, West Bengal, commissioned 23 April 2026; large-scale capex to be announced.
LFP cathode Phase 1: 40,000 MTPA, total capex INR 1,125 crores; first 2,000 MT by Q3 FY27, balance over subsequent 12 months, full by FY29. Long-term goal of 200,000 MTPA.
Anthraquinone and carbazole project to commission in Q2 FY27; PCR tyre capacity targeted within 24 months.
demand_pricing: Management says coal-tar-based carbon black and CTP price increases are passed through to customers; sees resilience despite West Asia volatility, citing nil dependence on that region for feedstock.
Export markets: 61 countries in FY26 vs 56 in FY25; Europe and US growing; Middle East shipments diverted to Southeast Asia and Africa.
Management claims no China competition in CTP given quality and cost, and sells CTP domestically below Chinese cost.
Cell component prices have fallen 50-60% over last 4-5 years, per management.
Customer engagement with Indian and global cell makers intensified; NDAs prevent disclosure of MOUs/LOIs for LFP offtake.

qa_highlights.question: Will the anode plant contribute meaningfully to revenue in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the 200 MT plant is for commercialising R&D and its revenue contribution is not material; large-scale anode capex to be announced next.

qa_highlights.question: Any top-line or margin guidance for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: No year-on-year guidance; management expects top-line and PAT growth in FY27 and said PAT (16%+ of revenue) is the better metric than EBITDA.

qa_highlights.question: Was there inventory gain in Q4 gross margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management denied any material inventory gain, attributing the margin expansion to yield improvement, operational efficiency and waste recovery.

qa_highlights.question: Why was other expense high?
qa_highlights.answer: Forex loss from hedging during sharp rupee depreciation; management said it had hedged this time against its standing open-position policy and expects no FX impact going forward.

qa_highlights.question: What is the FY26 standalone other income jump (INR 51 to 176 crores) composed of?
qa_highlights.answer: Driven by FDR interest, mutual fund gains, NCDs deployed for Birla Tyres and fair-value gains on investments.

qa_highlights.question: How will debt be managed given lower net cash and higher current borrowings?
qa_highlights.answer: Borrowings rose because bank limits were utilised to keep them intact; future expansion to be funded mainly by internal accruals, with any debt a small timing gap.

risks_watch: FX exposure: hedging losses inflated other expenses in Q4; management says policy reverts to open positions.
Net cash fell to INR 121 crores from INR 392 crores while standalone current borrowings rose to INR 719 crores from INR 306 crores; monitor debt trajectory.
Birla Tyres: top line only INR 187 crores; ramp, quality and channel expansion still early.
Anode and LFP: no disclosed offtake contracts; Phase 1 approvals and OEM validation remain open. Anode capex and capacity not yet announced.
West Asia geopolitical volatility in energy and logistics; management says costs will be passed on.
Revenue growth has been flat in recent years per analyst; management promises FY27 growth but gave no numbers.
summary.management_tone: Confident and expansive on growth pipeline and margins, but evasive on specific numbers (no FY27 guidance, no anode economics, no LFP offtake disclosure, no per-tonne pricing). Management was more direct on the forex loss and standalone other income.
key_quotes: We have committed to double this PAT in next three years in FY28 to INR 1,100 plus crores.
The right way to look at Himadri is not at EBITDA, but at PAT levels.
I don't think there will be any impact before or after Q1.
As such, we don't have impact on our P&L because of this geopolitical situation.
